causes.label: demand
causes.quote: High demand was driven by hot weather, which leads to the increased use of air conditioners, with the temperature reaching 34°C in Melbourne and 35°C in Adelaide.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Wind generation in South Australia at 6 pm was just 47 MW, well below the hour ahead forecast of 148 MW.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: EnergyAustralia's Yallourn units 1 and 2 had been experiencing outages due to tube-leaks (since 30 and 25 January, respectively). Each of these units has a registered capacity of 360 MW, so the outages collectively reduced availability by 720 MW.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: EnergyAustralia's Jeeralang B unit 3, in Victoria, removed 84 MW of capacity priced at the floor at 5.16 pm due to a unit trip.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: EnergyAustralia's Newport unit, also in Victoria, removed 30 MW of capacity priced at the floor at 3.04 pm due to a pressure limit.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: In South Australia, AGL's Torrens Island Power station, units 2, 3 and 4 collectively moved 30 MW of capacity from $150/MWh to $12,999/MWh at 5.19 pm, due to a change in forecast prices.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: The lower ramp rate meant that when the constraint bound, Murray could only be targeted to reduce its output slowly.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The network constraint invoked by AEMO limited the sum of output from Murray power station and imports into Victoria to 1100 MW.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: The Heywood interconnector was unconstrained so our analysis will consider Victoria and South Australia as one region.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Murray is located in Victoria close to the Vic-NSW interconnector, so when Murray's output is high it can cause congestion on the interconnector.
